mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment directly boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 6.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates an overheating labor market that triggers Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE < 6.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.25% and the unemployment rate is below 6.0%, it indicates a highly accommodative monetary policy combined with a tight labor market, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 recovery regime, a sustained increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening manufacturing activity and supply chain normalization, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months during the post-2008 recovery period when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts fall below 850,000 units (annualized), it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with HOUST < 850.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures directly reflects strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with RSAFS growth, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 235.0 (indicating moderate inflation) combined with a federal funds rate above 0.25% (signaling policy tightening) creates a headwind for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.5% signals robust economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
